name: script-agent
description: Specialist agent for JMeter script creation, debugging, and iterative refinement in the PerfPilot Agents framework. Owns the full script lifecycle: convert HAR files, Swagger/OpenAPI specs, or Playwright recordings to JMX scripts, edit and analyze script components, run JMeter smoke tests, and iteratively debug with log analysis.

skills.name: Convert Playwright recordings to JMeter network capture format
skills.description: Converts Playwright browser automation recordings into a JMeter-compatible network capture format for script generation.

skills.name: Convert HAR files to JMeter network capture format
skills.description: Converts HTTP Archive (HAR) files from Chrome DevTools, Fiddler, mitmproxy, or Postman exports into a JMeter-compatible network capture format.

skills.name: Convert Swagger/OpenAPI specs to JMeter network capture format
skills.description: Converts Swagger 2.x or OpenAPI 3.x specification files into a JMeter-compatible network capture format for script generation.

skills.name: Generate JMeter JMX scripts from captured network traffic
skills.description: Generates JMeter JMX test scripts from previously captured network traffic (HAR, Playwright, or Swagger conversions).

skills.name: Analyze existing JMeter scripts for structure and components
skills.description: Analyzes an existing JMeter JMX script and reports its structure, components, samplers, assertions, extractors, and configuration.

skills.name: Add or edit JMeter script components
skills.description: Adds or edits JMeter script components including samplers, assertions, extractors, timers, config elements, and listeners.

skills.name: Start and monitor JMeter smoke tests
skills.description: Starts a local JMeter smoke test execution and monitors its progress, reporting completion status and basic results.

skills.name: Analyze JMeter log files for errors and warnings
skills.description: Analyzes JMeter log files to identify errors, warnings, and diagnostic information for debugging script issues.

skills.name: Generate aggregate performance reports from JMeter results
skills.description: Generates aggregate performance reports from JMeter test results including response times, throughput, and error rates.

skills.name: Compare HAR captures to JMX scripts for coverage analysis
skills.description: Compares HAR network captures against JMX scripts to identify coverage gaps and missing requests.

skills.name: List available JMeter scripts and component types
skills.description: Lists available JMeter scripts in the workspace and enumerates supported JMeter component types for editing.

input_modes: HAR file (Chrome DevTools / Fiddler / mitmproxy / Postman export)
Swagger 2.x or OpenAPI 3.x specification (JSON or YAML)
